response.sql: WITH feature_data AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, SUM(traitcount) OVER () as total_traits, COUNT(*) OVER () as record_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL) SELECT zoneref, traitcount, CAST(traitcount AS FLOAT) / total_traits as share, CAST(traitcount AS FLOAT) / total_traits - 1.0 / record_count as margin FROM feature_data WHERE CAST(traitcount AS FLOAT) / total_traits > 1.0 / record_count ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing detected-feature counts" means excluding records where traitcount IS NULL from both the total and the count used to calculate average share (1/N). Records with NULL traitcount do not participate in the calculation at all.
